Portobello Institute established in 1981 offers Level 5-9 courses in Fashion, Sport, Early Years, SNA, Business, and Travel.

Portobello Institute is based in the heart of Dublin City Centre, delivering full-time and blended learning courses to a global student base. The Institute offers ordinary and honours degree programmes with paths of progression to Masters programmes #MakingEducationAccessible
